0022600003.text: The Spurs open their 2026-27 season at home against the Oklahoma City Thunder, who also have not yet played a game this season. San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance, who is out after knee surgery, and Tobias Harris is day-to-day with a calf strain and is a game-time decision. The teams met five times in 2025-26, with the Spurs winning the regular-season series 4-1 and the playoff series 4-3, including a 111-103 win in Oklahoma City on May 30, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Spurs a 55% chance of winning.
